description:
Plot 19 | Tramways House D03 | Rivermark

A 2 bedroom, 776 sq ft apartment located in Tramways House, Rivermark - Poplars newest destination. Designed to maximise space and light with floor to ceiling windows throughout. The apartment benefits from 2 balconies, one with access via the open plan living, kitchen, dining room and the other via the main bedroom. You can expect a high specification, including Bosch and Siemens appliances and underfloor heating. The main bedroom features built in wardrobes and an area for a dressing table or work from home space. A bathroom with elegant Porcelanosa tiles, a second bedroom and two storage cupboards complete the home.


Finished in the carefully crafted light interior colour palette, inspired by the local area & Rivermark's rich industrial heritage.

description:
A recently refurbished and upgraded throughout south facing, one bedroom apartment on the third floor of Magnolia Lodge within Kensington Green.

The apartment benefits from Juliette balconies off the reception room and bedroom, separate kitchen, one bathroom with bath and shower, built in storage and one underground car parking space.

Magnolia Lodge is located in the prestigious gated development of Kensington Green, moments` walk from the amenities and transport links of High Street Kensington. Kensington Green offers a 24 hour security and concierge service, award winning landscaped gardens and a residents only gymnasium.
